checks.pass_message: Document number present and follows project numbering convention
checks.fail_message: NO DOCUMENT NUMBER — document cannot be registered in Asite, BIM 360, or any EDMS. This is a hard rejection at every gateway.
NO REVISION — cannot determine if this is the latest issue. Construction has used wrong revisions on site, leading to rework costs.

checks.pass_message: Document status coded (e.g., S3 – Suitable for Review)
checks.fail_message: No suitability status — cannot determine if document is for information, review, or construction
No project name — document cannot be associated with a specific project
No date — cannot verify currency of document
No designer identified — design responsibility not clear
NO INDEPENDENT CHECKER — Category III check required for all permanent works. Unchecked designs have led to structural failures.
NO APPROVER — document is not authorized for use. Unsigned documents have been rejected at every design review in the past 3 years.
No author — accountability for technical content not established
Structure type not stated — basement, bridge, retaining wall, etc. must be classified
No design life — 50-year or 120-year requirement affects all material and durability decisions
No consequence class — structural reliability level not defined
No exposure class — durability and cover requirements cannot be verified
No concrete grade — cannot verify structural capacity or durability
No reinforcement grade — cannot verify steel specification
NO DESIGN STANDARDS REFERENCED — Eurocodes, BS EN, or equivalent must be stated. Designs without stated standards cannot be checked.
No groundwater level — critical for basement and foundation design. Unforeseen water has caused flooding and programme delays.
No soil information — geotechnical basis of design not established
No construction sequence — temporary works and staging not addressed
No drawings list — cannot verify all required drawings are included
No Eurocode reference — all UK structural design must reference Eurocodes (BS EN 1990-1999)
NO CDM REFERENCE — CDM 2015 compliance is a legal requirement. Missing CDM information has resulted in HSE enforcement notices.
No risk assessment — design risk register required under CDM 2015
No temporary works reference — propping, shoring, and staging must be considered
No waterproofing reference — critical for below-ground structures

checks.pass_message: Fire resistance or fire safety referenced
checks.fail_message: No fire reference — fire resistance period and strategy must be defined
No monitoring reference — instrumentation and monitoring plan may be needed for deep excavations
BS EN 1992 not referenced — required for all concrete design
BS EN 1997 not referenced — required for all geotechnical design

checks.pass_message: BS 8102 (Protection of below-ground structures against water from the ground) referenced
checks.fail_message: BS 8102 not referenced — required for any below-ground structure
